About the Role
In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis.
Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data. 
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Brazil (work from home)
Work Schedule: Part-time — 4 hours per day required. (Flexible schedule: you can choose your hours as long as the daily time requirement is met).  Work whenever you want.
Start Date: Immediately
Duration: TBC
Rate: 6 USD per hour
What You’ll Do
Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present in the audio and on-screen text.
Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., verifying that the media content uses authentic target language and aligns with the cultural context of that language).
Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines.
Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models.
What we’re looking for:
Must be currently living in Brazil.
Native-level written and spoken fluency in Portuguese.
Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop.
Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines.
(Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English.

At Toloka, we connect smart, curious people from around the world with freelance online tasks that train and improve artificial intelligence.

What we do

The Toloka Annotators connects individuals with Generative AI projects from leading tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the full potential of AI by involving real people from around the world in the development process.

About the Role

Annotation is what helps AI make sense of the world. As an annotator, you may be invited to take part in online projects such as rating AI-generated content, evaluating factual accuracy, or comparing responses - when projects are available.

Responsibilities:

  • Carefully review provided data (text, images, or videos)
  • Label or classify content based on project guidelines
  • Identify and flag factually incorrect, sensitive, inappropriate, or unclear material

Important note: This is project-based work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

Each project has its own compensation level based on scope and expertise required. On this project, AI trainers earn up to $9 per hour equivalent.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in any professional role
  • Advanced level of English (C1 or higher), both written and spoken
  • Logical thinking, fact-checking and reasoning abilities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to understand and follow complex instructions
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to ask clarifying questions when needed
  • Genuine interest in technology and artificial intelligence

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

vagas.titulo: Freelance: Grave Vídeos para Treinar IA
vagas.descricao:
Esta é uma oportunidade baseada em projetos em uma plataforma de treinamento de IA. Sem horário fixo, sem compromisso além do que se encaixa na sua rotina. Gravou, ganhou.

Sobre a Função

Estamos procurando pessoas para gravar vídeos em primeira pessoa de atividades domésticas do dia a dia. Você fixa o smartphone na cabeça, segue sua rotina normalmente, e a câmera captura exatamente o que você vê. Esses vídeos ajudam a treinar sistemas de IA e robôs a entender como as pessoas interagem com objetos em ambientes reais. Você lava louça todos os dias? Passa o aspirador no tapete? Passeia com o cachorro? Dobra roupa? E se você pudesse ganhar dinheiro apenas gravando isso? 

Responsabilidades

  • Gravar atividades domésticas do dia a dia em primeira pessoa — cozinhar, limpar, organizar, dobrar roupa, cuidar do jardim, passear com o cachorro, entre outras
  • Gravar em sua própria casa, quintal, garagem ou espaço de trabalho
  • Seguir orientações breves de gravação para cada sessão
  • Enviar os vídeos pelo aplicativo do projeto

Requisitos

  • Equipamento: Ter ou utilizar um smartphone ou outro dispositivo de câmera capaz de gravar a 30 FPS ou mais e resolução de 1080p ou superior. iPhone 12 ou mais recente, Google Pixel 6+ ou Samsung Galaxy S21+ (deve ter lente grande angular / 0.5x)
  • Método de captura: Fixar o dispositivo na altura da testa ou dos olhos para obter uma perspectiva egocêntrica, mantendo um ângulo levemente inclinado para baixo para maximizar a visibilidade das mãos
  • Software: Utilizar o aplicativo designado "D&A" para toda a captura e envio de dados
  • Controle de qualidade: Garantir que todas as filmagens estejam nítidas, estáveis, bem iluminadas, com pelo menos 15 segundos de duração, e que retratem tarefas úteis e intencionais, sem pausas desnecessárias ou movimentos forçados

Por que essa oportunidade freelance é perfeita para você? 

• Ganhe dinheiro enquanto faz suas tarefas domésticas: até o equivalente a $6 por hora, dependendo do projeto 

• Este é um trabalho freelance baseado em projetos — escolha as sessões de gravação de acordo com sua disponibilidade 

• Influencie o futuro de como a IA e os robôs entendem e interagem com o mundo real

vagas.titulo: POV Video Recording Job - Home & Daily Life Activities
vagas.descricao:
Looking for a flexible way to earn extra income?

We're inviting people to take part in an exciting AI training project by recording real, everyday activities from the comfort of your home. No studio, no special equipment — just you, your smartphone, and your daily routine.

Record whenever it's convenient for you, using your own device, while doing everyday tasks like cooking, cleaning, organizing spaces, doing laundry, or other household chores. Videos are recorded POV-style (point-of-view), simply from your own perspective.

What we offer:

  • Remote, flexible work
  • $6 USD per hour of approved content
  • Bonus for your first approved hour
  • No previous experience required

Requirements:

  • iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ or newer
  • Basic level of English
  • Internet access

Your recordings will help train the next generation of AI and robotics systems.

vagas.titulo: Record Your Daily Routine & Get Paid - AI Training (Remote)
vagas.descricao:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world
